name: Tide
author: byo-pop
description: Sets how fast the flood rises in the action game. 100 is the original's pace for the level and difficulty; 50 is half as fast, 200 twice; 0 holds the water back for good, for a game of pure puzzling. Takes effect from the next level. Games with it keep their own high scores and saved game.

settings.label: Flood speed (%)
settings.help: 100 is the original. 0 stops the water; a game then only ends when no pair is left.
